[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |role =Vault dweller |TV actor =[[Rachel Marsh]] }} {{Quotation|If they thawed everyone at once, that must mean it's [[Reclamation Day (event)|Reclamation Day]].|Claudia optimistic after awakening}} '''Claudia''' is a resident of [[Vault 31]] who appears in the [[Fallout TV series season 2|second season]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== Before the [[Great War]], Claudia lived in [[Los Angeles]]. She had a pet cat which she ironically named Puppy, entirely on purpose.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"You okay?"''
Claudia: ''Sorry. You'd think it would have all hit me at once, but, uh... (sniffling) Nope. (sighs) Even if my parents survived the bombs, they'd be gone by now. Same with my friends. My cat. (sniffling)"''
Norm: ''"Your cat have a name?"''
Claudia: ''"His name was Puppy."''
Norm: ''"Puppy the cat."''
Claudia: ''"It's funny, huh?"''
Norm: ''"I mean, not right now, I guess."''
Claudia: ''"(inhales sharply) Yeah."''
({{FOTV|2|5}}) In mid-October [[Timeline (2050-2099)#2077|2077]], Claudia took part in a job interview for Vault-Tec at their [[Vault-Tec headquarters (TV series)|Los Angeles headquarters]] just a week before the Great War, and was subsequently accepted to work for the company within that week.[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"Must be a lot to take in."''
Claudia: ''"I drove down across that bridge a week ago."''
Norm: ''"Where were you going?"''
Claudia: ''"A job interview at Vault-Tec."''
Norm: ''"Pretty crazy week for you, I guess."''
Claudia: ''"(mouthing) Yeah."''
({{FOTV|2|4}}) There, she met [[Bud Askins]] as well as Bud's boss, [[Barb Howard]],[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"You don't strike me as the kind of person who would sign up for a program like this. Did you know going in about the Future Enterprise Ventures?"''
Claudia: ''"Like I said, I just started this job a week ago. But everything these people talked about sounded pretty nutty to me."''
Norm: ''"But you don't remember what they said? Nothing about doing something to the people in Vault 32 or 33?"''
Claudia: ''"No. There was this exec. Bud's boss? Her name was Barbara Howard. She was in charge of all the Vault proposals."''
({{FOTV|2|5}})[[Ronnie McCurtry]]: ''"Don't worry."''
Claudia: ''"Ronnie!"''
Ronnie: ''"We'll give him a fair trial."''
Claudia: ''"Stop! No, don't!"''
Ronnie: ''"This is America, after all."''
Claudia: ''"Stop! What are you gonna do to him?"''
Ronnie: ''"You're not one of us either, Claudia. You only got this job last week."''
({{FOTV|2|8}}) and was seemingly fast-tracked by Bud into his human resources research and Vault experiment program "[[Bud's Buds]]." The program's intention was for its selected junior executive trainees to survive the nuclear apocalypse via [[cryonics|cryonic preservation]] inside [[Vault 31]]. Over the ensuing centuries, they were then be released into [[Vault 32|Vaults 32]] and [[Vault 33|33]] to gain leadership and indoctrinate and breed with these Vaults' dwellers to create a class of loyal Vault-Tec "super managers." Due to her extremely new arrival to Vault-Tec, Claudia did not share the dogmatic faith in Bud Askins and his plans, or the cutthroat personality, that all of the other [[Vault 31 dweller|Bud's Buds trainees]] did. As such, Claudia viewed Bud's plans as "weird" and her fellow trainees as obsessive and "nutty," and they in turn viewed her as an outsider to some degree.Claudia: ''"Who even are you, seriously?"''
[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"I'm the product of 200 years of genetic engineering. Part of a race of super managers. And all of you have been selected to be my staff. You think we've been left locked in Vault 31 by accident? You think Bud Askins made mistakes?"''
[[Clark (TV series)|Clark]]: ''"Never."''
[[Pete (TV series)|Pete]]: ''"No chance."''
Claudia: ''"Well..."''
Clark: ''"Oh, my God, Claudia, we're trying to have a conversation here."''
({{FOTV|2|2}}) Claudia even recognized that her coworkers' obsession could make them incredibly dangerous, if Bud's plans were ever threatened.Claudia: ''"You're not really Bud's successor, are you?"''
[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"How'd you know?"''
Claudia: ''"Mm. Because you're not absolutely nuts?"''
Norm: ''"Thank you?"''
Claudia: ''"But the rest of them, they are nuts. I mean, they bet their whole lives on Bud Askins and his weird multi-millennial plan. If they realize you took that from them, there's no telling what they'll do. Sorry if that came across as a little dramatic. But in my defense, I did just see the world end, like, a week ago. I could really use a drink. Do you want a drink?"''
Norm: ''"I've actually never had one."''
Claudia: ''"Really? I'll be right back."''
({{FOTV|2|5}}) Regardless, she still vaguely went along with the corporate culture,[[Norm MacLean]]: ''"This is Bud's final test. If I can lead you all to finding our way out of here, we'll have proven ourselves worthy to carry on Vault-Tec's corporate strategy together. And those of you who work quickly and as a team... will receive these merit dots."''
[[Vault 31 dweller|Vault 31er]]: ''"Ooh!"''
[[Clark (TV series)|Clark]]: ''"Merit dots?"''
Claudia: ''"Oh."''
Clark: ''"Wait. I took notes at a meeting with the company that installed ventilation. Dibs on ventilation!"''
Claudia: ''"Oh, the fire suppression system. Maybe we can get some water from there."''
Vault 31er 1: ''"Maybe we could borrow{{sic}} underground, make a tunnel."''
Vault 31er 2: ''"I'll hack the Overseer's console, so we can override some security protocols."''
Vault 31er 3: ''"There has to be a schematics{{sic}} somewhere around here…"''
({{FOTV|2|2}}) and when the Great War struck, she was cryonically frozen in Vault 31 alongside the other trainees. Over the next 219 years, some members of the program were released. Most of them, Claudia included, remained preserved in Vault 31 until [[Norm MacLean]] derailed Bud's plans by unfreezing them all at once in July 2296, also killing Bud Askins, in an attempt to escape Vault 31. Tricking the 31ers into believing that [[Reclamation Day (event)|Reclamation Day]] had arrived and that he was their new leader (succeeding the now-deceased Bud Askins), Norm posed escaping from Vault 31 as their final test from Bud. With their collective knowledge, Norm, Claudia, and all of the other 31ers managed to return to the surface.{{FOTV|2|2}} While the other 31ers seemed unaffected by the devastation, Claudia was left distraught at the realization that the whole world had changed and everyone she had known was now likely dead. She took an interest in Norm, recognizing that he was lying about his role since he was not obsessed with Vault-Tec like all of the other trainees. As such, when Norm's lie was outed to the rest of the Vault 31ers while they were trying to continue their plans in the Vault-Tec headquarters, Claudia was the only one who tried to defend Norm. Her attempts to stop [[Ronnie McCurtry]] from executing Norm inadvertently led to the entire group being attacked by [[Radroach (TV series)|radroaches]]. While many of the 31ers were killed, Claudia and Norm both survived, and Norm has since taken Claudia away from the building, seemingly to send her "home."[[Norm MacLean]] (to Claudia): ''"You're okay. Let's get you home."''
({{FOTV|2|8}}) ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Golden Rule]]=== Claudia is awoken by Norm MacLean from her Vault 31 cryo pod in July 2296, along with the other Vault-Tec employees frozen in Vault 31. Norm, who has been trapped in Vault 31, had awoken them early in a last-ditch effort to escape the Vault, having been trapped inside by Bud Askins. Amidst the disorientation suffered by the other Vault 31 dwellers, who are changing into their Vault jumpsuits, Claudia discovers that she is temporarily blinded, though [[Clark (TV series)|Clark]] dismisses all of her concerns. When Norm addresses the group to try and explain what is happening, Claudia optimistically assumes that Reclamation Day has arrived; Norm picks up on this for his lie, but when he reveals that Bud Askins is dead, Claudia and all of the other Vault 31ers begin to panic, with Claudia pointing out that someone (Norm) has eaten the snacks in her welcoming kit. After a while, Norm manages to quiet down the group. Claudia prompts him to explain who he is; Norm convinces the group that he is one of Bud's "super managers" and that they have been awoken to serve under him, with escaping the Vault being their final test. Claudia reacts positively to Norm's incentive of "merit dots" for making progress in the escape. As the dwellers begin to develop ideas, she suggests using the Vault's fire suppression system to get potable water for their journey. The 31ers manage to work together, and eventually, they escape to the surface of [[Santa Monica]] via a maintenance hatch, gazing out at the ruins of the [[Santa Monica Pier]]. ===[[The Demon in the Snow]]=== [[File:FTV S2E4 Still 150.png|thumb|250px|Claudia speaking to Norm.]] The executives and Norm have managed to reach [[Los Angeles]], where they raid a ruined [[BlamCo]] truck for food. Norm notices Claudia staring pensively at a bridge. She informs him that she had crossed that bridge only a week earlier (in her perception of time) on her way to a job interview at Vault-Tec, and she is still coming to terms with the fact that over two centuries have passed since then. ===[[The Wrangler]]=== The group enter the abandoned [[Vault-Tec headquarters (TV series)|Vault-Tec headquarters]], where Ronnie, Clark, and [[Pete (TV series)|Pete]] act callously and display complete apathy towards the devastation around them, including making fun of the receptionist [[Janice (TV series)|Janice]]'s remains, still at her desk, which Claudia observes. Norm notices blood next to a boarded up elevator shaft and begins to warn the group before loud banging and chittering noises are heard from inside, frightening everyone, including Claudia. Before they can do anything, [[Ma June]] and [[Barv]] confront them at gunpoint, before noticing their Vault suits. Norm goes to speak with Ma June, while Claudia sits near the elevators and asks Barv about the banging noises; Barv reveals that it's a [[Radroach (TV series)|radroach]] farm the two are cultivating. Ma June and Barv leave after warning Norm to return to the safety of his Vault. Ma June gives them permission to take supplies, but warns not to touch the radroach farm. Later, the 31ers begin searching the offices deeper inside the Vault-Tec headquarters. Inside the comms room, Norm notices Claudia crying nearby and goes to comfort her; she explains she is taking the end of the world hard, having realized that her parents, her cat, and anyone else who she knew before the war are now dead. Noting that Claudia's personality does not match the rest of the Bud's Buds trainees, Norm asks Claudia about a term that Ronnie had mentioned called "Future Enterprise Ventures," but she does not know due to having only been at Vault-Tec for a week prior to the Great War. However, she does remember Barb Howard, Bud's boss, suggesting that Barb worked on all of the Vault proposals and thus might have known about the term. Claudia takes Norm to Barb's former office, where he begins hacking into her [[terminal]]. Watching Norm work, Claudia reveals her suspicion that Norm isn't actually Bud's successor. Norm confirms this and asks how she figured it out; she tells him that she noticed he was not "absolutely nuts" like the other 31ers, a feeling which Norm reciprocates towards Claudia. However, Claudia then warns him to be careful of the other 31ers, who could attack Norm if they discover his deception. She then leaves to get them both a drink. Unbeknownst to either of them, Ronnie eavesdropped on their conversation and learned Norm's secret as well, and he subsequently attacks and incapacitates Norm. ===[[The Handoff]]=== Ronnie, Clark, and Pete agree to execute Norm for impersonating a Vault-Tec employee. Claudia returns, waking Norm and untying his hands, telling him they need to flee. Norm agrees, but still goes to send a message over the radio to [[Lucy MacLean|his sister]] and [[Hank MacLean|father]] before escaping. However, after he finishes his message, the other 31ers find them and block their path. ===[[The Strip]]=== The assembled 31ers, led by Ronnie, are dragging Norm away to be executed. As Claudia runs up through the crowd of 31ers to try to get to Ronnie, she urges them to stop, only to get a promise from Ronnie that Norm will receive a "fair trial" as befitting of the United States of America before his punishment. As Claudia makes it closer to Ronnie, he tells her off, saying that she is also "not one of [them]" due to having only joined Vault-Tec a week before the Great War. Devastated, Claudia tries to physically free Norm by pushing away the [[executive assistant]] who is dragging him as the group passes through the elevator hall. As she leans down to grab Norm, Ronnie forcefully throws her against the wall, causing her body to accidentally press the elevator button and open the elevator shaft. This releases the radroaches, who start to attack the Vault 31 dwellers. Amidst the chaos, the 31ers run for shelter in a break room, with Claudia joining them inside. Norm is the last one outside; though Claudia tries to let him in, Ronnie stops her from doing so and shuts Norm out. However, the disturbance makes Ronnie unable to fully close the door before the radroaches get in and start to slaughter the 31ers, while Norm is safe as the door closes behind them. In the aftermath of the radroach attack, Norm enters the room and finds Claudia wounded but alive, apparently having killed the radroach attacking her with a screwdriver. Norm then takes Claudia out and puts her on a cart before leaving the Vault-Tec headquarters, promising to "get [her] home." ==Notes== {{Note|(Note)}} As seen in "[[The Golden Rule]]," Claudia appears to have emerged from the cryo chamber labeled for [[Joanne Wormwood]]. When Claudia is first released from her chamber, she is seen in a chamber in the middle of one set of three on the bottom left row from the entrance, and the second set of newly-opened cryo chambers on the bottom row can also be seen in the distance behind her. This means that she must have been in the second chamber on the bottom left from the entrance, which is exactly the one that had Joanne Wormwood's name on it. ==Appearances== Claudia appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances |10=202 |12=204 |13=205 |15=207 |16=208 }} ==Gallery== FTV S2E2 Still 165.png FTV S2E2 Still 168.png FTV S2E2 Still 175.png|Claudia holding a snack wrapper from her plundered welcome kit FTV S2E2 Still 336.png FTV S2E4 Still 153.png ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Vault 31 characters]] [[Category:Vault-Tec characters]] [[ru:Клаудия (телесериал)]]
